name: august
description:
august builds Digital Twins of the people your business needs to understand. Digital Twins are mirrors of your real customers trained on your data to think, make decisions and respond like their real-life counterparts.

This connector allows you to Interview your Digital Twins and create Focus Groups directly in Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add august to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add august to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getaugust.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the august MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: august lists 32 MCP tools, including add_focus_group_stimuli, ask_question, end_focus_group, get_focus_group_results, get_interview_transcript, list_conversations, list_focus_groups, list_organizations, list_twins, run_focus_group_round, start_focus_group, and start_interview.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to august?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to august in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
august requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
august is developed by Fermat Commerce. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
